card_en: A noun's ending usually shows its gender: a consonant for masculine (brat, sin), -a for feminine (sestra, mama), -o or -e for neuter (jutro, ime). Moj, my, follows: moj sin, moja hčerka, moje ime. Oče is an exception: masculine.

quick_check.explain_en: Družina ends in -a, so it is feminine and takes moja: moja družina.

helper_de: German shows gender on der, die, das. Slovenian has no article, so the ending of the noun shows it.
helper_en: English nouns have no gender. Every Slovenian noun has one, and moj, my, changes with it.
